newsitem.title: USA: Regent, Carnegie end merger pact.
newsitem.headline: Regent, Carnegie end merger pact.

text.p: Regent Bancshares Corp and Carnegie Bancorp Wednesday said they agreed to end their merger agreement.

David Ring, chairman of Regent, and Thomas Gray Jr., president of Carnegie, said both institutions had shifted their respective strategic focus during the "very extended period of the merger agreement."
However they said both institutions continue to participate with each other in mutually advantageous lending arrangements.
Ring also said Regent had retained the investment banking firm of Keefe, Bruyette & Woods Inc of New York to assist Regent's board of directors in their evaluation of strategic alternatives.
